# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.10

This release fixes authenticated RX Softphone calls that could disconnect
immediately after the PBX answered.

## Call stability fix

- RX Softphone 0.4.4 retains the optional Grandstream UCM Authentication ID
  introduced in 0.4.3.
- Outbound calls again use the proven SIPSorcery `From`, canonical `To`, and
  SDP content-type descriptor fields.
- A separate Authentication ID is used only as the digest username; the
  visible extension remains the SIP identity.
- A credential-safe diagnostic event records an in-dialog `BYE` received from
  the remote SIP endpoint.

## Validation

- The 0.4.3 failure was reproduced against the local Grandstream UCM: the PBX
  returned `200 OK`, followed by a disconnect approximately 9 ms later.
- The 0.4.4 candidate rang, answered, remained connected for approximately
  52 seconds, and ended normally through the softphone hangup control.
- Managed relay, phone-client, phone-account setup, Call Center attempt,
  application regression, migration-ledger, JavaScript, and Windows build
  checks passed.

## Official Windows assets

- `server-update-4.0.0-next.10.zip` for the RX Tracker server;
- `RxSoftphone-0.4.4-win-x64.zip` for managed calling workstations;
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` covering both ZIPs and compiled executables.

RX Tracker requires managed workstation version 0.4.4 or later after this
update. Existing relay pairing survives an in-place workstation upgrade when
the same persistent Windows user profile is retained.

## Database impact

None. This release adds no migration and changes no table, column, index,
constraint, patient record, RX record, call record, pairing, or credential.

Deploy through the standard staging, develop, and main promotion flow. Keep
the production `.env` unchanged and use Project Control option 15 only after
the release is approved.
